cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:26.title: Staff Accountant - Construction
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:26.description: Position Overview We are seeking a highly driven, self-starting Staff Accountant with a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and 5+ years of hands-on experience. This is not a typical back-office accounting role. A critical priority will be building our inventory processes from the ground up. We need someone eager to evaluate, implement, and manage a robust inventory tracking system as we scale.
responsibilities: Key Responsibilities
Sole Accounting Ownership: Manage all full-cycle accounting functions independently, handling both high-level financial tasks and daily hands-on data entry.

Document Control & Compliance: Oversee complete document control for all financial files, job files, vendor records, tax documentation, and receipts to maintain immaculate records and audit readiness.

Inventory Implementation & Oversight: Lead the selection, setup, and rollout of a modern inventory tracking system; establish best practices for physical inventory counts, raw material tracking, and valuation.
General Ledger & Financial Operations: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable/receivable, job costing, and month-end closing procedures.
Systems Utilization & Payroll Support: Leverage QuickBooks, ADP, and Excel to drive efficient bookkeeping and reporting; assist with payroll-related tasks, reporting, and data entry as needed.
Financial Integrity & Analysis: Analyze financial and job data, face facts directly identifying variances and presenting actionable solutions without sugarcoating realities.
Cross-Functional Team Support: Fill gaps across department operations by proactively supporting team members in areas where financial, inventory, or administrative assistance is needed.
Organizational Advocacy: Defend organizational interests and team integrity through accurate reporting, compliance enforcement, and sound financial stewardship.
qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Required).

Experience: 5+ years of progressive accounting experience; background in construction or manufacturing is strongly preferred. Comfortable working as a sole accountant handling both strategy and daily data entry.
Software Proficiency: Proficiency in QuickBooks, ADP, and advanced Excel for streamlined bookkeeping and reporting.
Core Competencies: Exceptional attention to detail in data entry, document control, time management, and problem-solving.
Inventory Expertise: Demonstrated experience or strong eagerness to implement and manage an inventory system from scratch.
Mindset: Self-starter with high accountability, strong analytical skills, and a direct, reality-based approach to financial reporting.
Team-First Approach: Willingness to jump in, support peers, and protect the team's shared goals and reputation.
Adaptability: Thrives under pressure, handles shifting priorities, and excels in a high-energy, dynamic atmosphere.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ce7450e9-33ab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in India. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Implement and validate web accessibility in accordance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 requirements. Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices. Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate. Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment. Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems. Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality. Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation. Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities. Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Windows envi
